description: This file contains functions for configuring command-line interface options for a Software Radio (SDR) Radio Unit (RU) using CLI11 library. It defines various configuration functions for amplitude control, radio parameters, logging, CPU affinities, thread profiles, and overall schema setup, including parsing and default handling.

methods.name: configure_cli11_amplitude_control_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for amplitude control parameters.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_sdr_expert_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for radio SDR expert parameters, including transmission mode and power ramping.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ru_sdr_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for general radio SDR parameters such as sample rate, device, gains, frequency offsets, and subcommands for amplitude and expert configs.

methods.name: configure_cli11_log_args
methods.description: Sets up CLI options for logging levels.

methods.name: configure_cli11_cell_affinity_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for CPU affinity settings for the radio unit.

methods.name: configure_cli11_lower_phy_threads_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for lower PHY thread profile (single, dual, triple).

methods.name: configure_cli11_expert_execution_args
methods.description: Configures CLI options for expert execution settings, including threads and cell affinities.

methods.name: configure_cli11_metrics_args
methods.description: Sets up CLI options for enabling radio unit metrics.

methods.name: configure_cli11_with_ru_sdr_config_schema
methods.description: Main function to add all subcommands and options for configuring the RU SDR schema via CLI.

methods.name: autoderive_ru_sdr_parameters_after_parsing
methods.description: Post-processing function to adjust parsed configuration, e.g., setting default thread profile for zmq device driver.
